rules.works: Positions 4-6 of the seeded work order (the first rigorous round's works, R01-D8); every other work stays closed.
rules.pool: transcript-muscriptor-large, program below 128, not drums, mapped or baked timing (as in round 1)
rules.window: N consecutive notes of one pool asset in decoded order (start tick, track, ID). The first note is the first at its start tick and the next note after the window, if any, starts later, so no chord is split. Onsets are relative to the first note; durations are complete. There is no quarter cap.
rules.refusal: A window with a normalization collision (two notes sharing pitch and 1/512-normalized onset) is refused, as is one on which a target rule of a family using that size finds no case (range-edit at every size; selective-delete planting at 128 notes for each delete level).
rules.assignment: Instance k at size N uses the ((k - 1) mod W + 1)-th of the W works with an admissible window at N, in seeded work order. Within a work, candidates of all its assets are ordered by seeded asset order, then start. The first use of a work takes the first admissible candidate; a later use takes the admissible candidate whose largest overlap (shared notes) with that work's earlier windows at N is smallest, then the smallest total overlap, then the earlier candidate; no window repeats an earlier instance.
rules.velocities: Admission checks use velocities from r01-round2-velocity-v1, as the tasks do.
